Wafer page

Web·by @kazarov_d·2026-09-02·inspora page·original post

What it is

Full marketing-to-product walkthrough for 'Wafer' (serverless LLM): dithered vintage seascape painting backdrop, centered dark auth card (GitHub/Google/email), then onboarding ('Let's set up your serverless LLM') with model/plan pricing rows, API-key step with code block, scrolling into the dashboard.

Media

App shell fades in: left icon rail (wafer logo, Home, API keys, Billing, Usage, Docs, Team), centered welcome 'Welcome to Wafer. Let's set up your serverless LLM.' with step content below.

More plan tiers scroll past (prices per 1M tokens); a modal 'Unlimited?...' briefly appears top.

Build prompt

Recreate the Wafer page aesthetic and flow. Background: a classical seascape painting processed with ordered (Bayer 4x4) dithering at 2-3px pixel size, slightly desaturated, fixed full-bleed; overlay a soft vertical gradient so the center reads darker. Auth card: 380px near-black rounded-2xl card, wordmark, 'Welcome to Wafer' + subline, GitHub/Google SSO outline buttons with icons, divider 'or', email + password fields, primary white 'Create an account' button, footer legal line. On submit, crossfade (400ms) into the app shell: 56px left icon rail (logo + 7 icons + avatar) and a max-w-2xl centered onboarding column. Welcome headline fades+rises 12px (500ms ease-out). Steps stack as the user scrolls: model-picker dark card with radio and sparkle glyph; plan rows in a bordered list with per-row hover, right-aligned prices; API-key step with a dark syntax-highlighted code block and a green flip toggle. Each section reveals with the same 12px rise + fade at 60ms stagger. Typography: 13-14px UI sans, 12px muted labels.
